title: Windows routing + DNS path audit
description: Read-only Windows 11 audit to map all active network adapters, IPv4 addresses, gateways, interface/route metrics, DNS servers, default routes, and effective paths to 3EN002 (192.168.1.2), Pi-hole (192.168.1.3), and the Internet. Designed to explain why 10.131.32.1 appears as the preferred default gateway. No configuration changes are made.
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; Write-Host '=== WINDOWS ROUTING + DNS PATH AUDIT 011 ==='; Write-Host ('Time='+(Get-Date -Format o)); Write-Host ''; Write-Host '=== NET ADAPTERS ==='; Get-NetAdapter | Sort-Object ifIndex | Format-Table ifIndex,Name,InterfaceDescription,Status,MacAddress,LinkSpeed -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 240 | Write-Host; Write-Host '=== IP CONFIGURATION ==='; Get-NetIPConfiguration -Detailed | Format-List InterfaceAlias,InterfaceIndex,NetProfile,IPv4Address,IPv4DefaultGateway,DNSServer | Out-String -Width 240 | Write-Host; Write-Host '=== IPV4 INTERFACES ==='; Get-NetIPInterface -AddressFamily IPv4 | Sort-Object InterfaceMetric,InterfaceIndex | Format-Table InterfaceIndex,InterfaceAlias,ConnectionState,Dhcp,AutomaticMetric,InterfaceMetric,NlMtu -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 240 | Write-Host; Write-Host '=== IPV4 ADDRESSES ==='; Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Sort-Object InterfaceIndex,IPAddress | Format-Table InterfaceIndex,InterfaceAlias,IPAddress,PrefixLength,AddressState,PrefixOrigin,SuffixOrigin -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 240 | Write-Host; Write-Host '=== DNS PER INTERFACE ==='; Get-DnsClientServerAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Sort-Object InterfaceIndex | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('IFINDEX='+$_.InterfaceIndex+' ALIAS='+$_.InterfaceAlias+' DNS='+($_.ServerAddresses -join ',')) }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '=== DEFAULT ROUTES ==='; Get-NetRoute -AddressFamily IPv4 -DestinationPrefix '0.0.0.0/0' | Sort-Object RouteMetric,InterfaceMetric,InterfaceIndex | Format-Table InterfaceIndex,InterfaceAlias,NextHop,RouteMetric,InterfaceMetric,State,Protocol -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 240 | Write-Host; Write-Host '=== FULL IPV4 ROUTE TABLE ==='; Get-NetRoute -AddressFamily IPv4 | Sort-Object DestinationPrefix,RouteMetric,InterfaceMetric | Format-Table InterfaceIndex,InterfaceAlias,DestinationPrefix,NextHop,RouteMetric,InterfaceMetric,State,Protocol -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 260 | Write-Host; Write-Host '=== EFFECTIVE ROUTE LOOKUPS ==='; foreach($dst in '192.168.1.2','192.168.1.3','1.1.1.1','8.8.8.8'){ Write-Host ('--- DEST='+$dst+' ---'); try { Find-NetRoute -RemoteIPAddress $dst | Format-List | Out-String -Width 240 | Write-Host } catch { Write-Host ('FIND_ROUTE_FAIL='+$_.Exception.Message) }; try { $tnc=Test-NetConnection -ComputerName $dst -InformationLevel Detailed -WarningAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ('PING='+$tnc.PingSucceeded); Write-Host ('SOURCE='+$tnc.SourceAddress); Write-Host ('IF_ALIAS='+$tnc.InterfaceAlias); Write-Host ('IF_INDEX='+$tnc.InterfaceIndex); Write-Host ('NEXT_HOP='+$tnc.NetRoute.NextHop) } catch { Write-Host ('TNC_FAIL='+$_.Exception.Message) } }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '=== DNS TESTS ==='; foreach($name in 'pi.hole','google.com'){ try { $r=Resolve-DnsName $name -Type A -DnsOnly -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object {$_.IPAddress} | Select-Object -ExpandProperty IPAddress; Write-Host ($name+'='+($r -join ',')) } catch { Write-Host ($name+'=FAIL '+$_.Exception.Message) } }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '=== ROUTE PRINT ==='; route print -4 | Out-String -Width 260 | Write-Host; Write-Host '=== AUDIT END ==='
test: Write-Host 'WINDOWS ROUTING + DNS AUDIT 011 COLLECTION PASS'
